array.string: Just another dull night in an intergalactic garbage belt.
The trace to their system leads you through the nebula. You never know what might lurk in there...
You've made it to the "human" solar system, but you took a wrong turn and ended up in an asteroid belt.
There seems to be mining activity in this ateroid. This could be fun...
A space station? Finally something real to destroy!
The red planet? More like orange I'd say... I wonder if there's anything down there...
Earth... looks like it's going to start raining, better hurry.
While blasting through the space junk your scanners show something interesting ahead...
Hmmm, this green slime stuff is really getting on my nerve, I wonder where it comes from...
Rocks, gravel and spacedust everywhere, this is terrible! I'll never get this ship clean again...
I'm really enjoying this. I wonder what's at the end of the tunnel.
Sure are a lot of blinking lights and such around here. I wonder what powers it all...
This is getting sort of dull, with the desert and all... Hmm, buildings ahead I think...
Going into orbit, looks like I'm expected.
Since you don't have anything else to do you decide to find the makers of the drone you just destroyed.
Damn those space-monsters, it's always like this...
Oh goodie, they put up a fight. Now that I'm here I might as well destroy 'em all.
Nothing beats flying in cramped spaces! I haven't had this much fun in several weeks!
They really should be more carefull with those reactors, they break down so easily...
No more colony I guess, onward! To Earth!
That last bit... well, that was just strange...
